# notes: Updated to 2026 model landscape. Most proprietary models (Claude
column3: Gemini) do not disclose parameter counts or detailed energy data. Training CO2 estimates are from published papers
column5: and third-party analyses. Inference CO2 estimates use multiple methods: (1) provider disclosures where available
column6: (2) active-parameter scaling for MoE models relative to DeepSeek V3 baseline
column7: (3) energy-to-CO2 conversion for Google's Wh/query figures
column8: (4) cost-based proxy estimates for fully proprietary models. All estimates are tagged with confidence levels and estimation methods. MoE models show total/active params where known.

column10: Anthropic does not disclose parameter counts or energy data. Largest Claude model. Estimate: cost-based proxy assuming high-end inference similar to GPT-4.1 (~$15/1M output tokens). Method: comparative cost scaling.
Anthropic does not disclose parameter counts or energy data. Mid-tier model. Estimate: cost-based proxy (~$3/1M output tokens). Method: comparative cost scaling relative to Opus and Haiku.

Anthropic does not disclose parameter counts or energy data. Smallest/fastest Claude model. Estimate: cost-based proxy (~$1.25/1M output tokens suggests efficient inference). Method: comparative cost scaling.
OpenAI does not disclose parameter counts or inference energy. 1M context window model. Estimate: cost-based proxy (~$10/1M output tokens). Method: comparative cost scaling to other frontier models.

Smaller distilled model. Significantly lower inference energy than GPT-4.1. Estimate: cost-based proxy (~$0.60/1M output tokens suggests 3x efficiency gain vs GPT-4.1). Method: comparative cost scaling.

Reasoning model with chain-of-thought. Higher inference energy per query due to extended reasoning tokens. Estimate: cost-based proxy (~$15-60/1M tokens depending on reasoning depth). Method: high-reasoning overhead assumption.

MoE architecture. Google reports 0.24 Wh per median query (~1000 tokens). Estimate: 0.24 Wh/1K tokens = 240 Wh/1M tokens = 0.24 kWh/1M. Using 30% grid intensity (renewables) * 500 g CO2/kWh = 36 g/1M tokens. Method: energy-to-CO2 conversion.

Flash variant optimized for speed/efficiency. Google reported 33x energy reduction over 12 months (2024-2025). Estimate: Gemini Pro baseline / 33 = 1.1 g/1M tokens. Method: relative efficiency scaling from Google disclosure.

675B total / 41B active (MoE). Open-weight. Mistral AI previously reported ~1g CO2 per page for Large 2. Estimate: active-parameter scaling from DeepSeek V3 (37B active / 30g): 41B/37B * 30 = 33.2 g/1M tokens. Method: MoE active-parameter scaling.

400B total / 17B active (MoE with 128 experts). Open-weight. Very efficient inference due to low active params. Estimate: active-parameter scaling from DeepSeek V3: 17B/37B * 30 = 13.8 g/1M tokens. Method: MoE active-parameter scaling.

235B total / 22B active (MoE). Open-weight. No public CO2 or energy data from Alibaba Cloud. Estimate: active-parameter scaling from DeepSeek V3: 22B/37B * 30 = 17.8 g/1M tokens. Method: MoE active-parameter scaling.

671B total / 37B active (MoE). Training cost ~$5.6M using 2.788M H800 GPU-hours. Highly efficient inference due to low active params. Inference CO2 extrapolated from training cost and hardware efficiency. Method: provider disclosure (estimated from published data).
